segments.he: הרה"צ ר' דוב בער בן הרב הצדיק ר' שניאור זלמן הרב מלאדי אמר על מוהרנ"ת ז"ל שהוא עלוי בחסידות:
segments.en: Reb Avraham said: what Rabbainu says in Likutay Moharan chapter 155 — that one must beseech Hashem that one should have yearning for Eretz Yisroel, and that the Tzaddikim should have yearning for Eretz Yisroel — there is also in this a hint and intention to beseech that all of our fellowship should have yearning for Eretz Yisroel. [For the Adversary places himself specifically upon those who serve Hashem so that they should not have yearning — making it seem to them that in the Diaspora they serve Hashem better. But in truth this is false, for Eretz Yisroel is like a vessel of water placed on a fire — at first it seems clear, but when heated one sees it is full of sand. And then the sand is poured off and it becomes clear again — until it becomes truly entirely clean. So it is with coming to Eretz Yisroel: before one comes, one thinks oneself a decent person — but when one comes, the truth is shown that one is not yet clean. And Eretz Yisroel purifies gradually until one becomes truly clean.]
